arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && stat -c "%s %n" entry.py && find /app/submission -type f | wc -l && find /app/submission -type l | wc -l && python3 -c "
import ast
src = open('/app/submission/entry.py').read()
tree = ast.parse(src)
imports = set()
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Import): imports.update(a.name for a in node.names)
    elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom): imports.add(node.module)
print('imports:', sorted(imports))
print('lines:', len(src.splitlines()), 'bytes:', len(src))
print('has subprocess/socket/open?', any(w in src for w in ['subprocess','socket','urllib','open(','exec(','eval(','__import__']))
"
